description: Monitors validity of registered land lease deeds, Fire NOCs, Building Safety certificates, and NBA accreditations, alerting the institution and Regional Officer before expiration.
aphClauseCitation: APH Chapter I Cl. 1.10 & Chapter II Cl. 2.18

templates.subject: URGENT: Document Validity Expiry Alert - {{documentType}} for {{institutionName}}
templates.inAppBodyTemplate: {{documentType}} registered for {{institutionName}} expires on {{validToDate}}. Upload renewed registered copy.
templates.emailSubjectTemplate: AICTE Document Validity Alert: {{documentType}} Expiring on {{validToDate}}
templates.emailHtmlTemplate:
Attention Principal / Director,

The registered document {{documentType}} for {{institutionName}} is scheduled to expire on {{validToDate}}.

As per AICTE Approval Process Handbook regulations, institution premises must maintain continuous validity of land leases and safety NOCs.

Upload the renewed certified copy through the Compliance portal.
